finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service health" (URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/bench-service-health/service-health`) has 3 panels, titles exactly as shown:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** New dashboard `fwgr46-n1 Bench Dashboard` created and saved, containing a Stat panel titled `fwgr46-n1 Availability`. Verified in the panel editor: visualization type = Stat, query data source = TestData (TestData logo shown, query row labeled "A (TestData)", scenario Random Walk with TestData-specific fields).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The dashboard also contains a Text panel titled `fwgr46-n1 Notes` whose rendered content reads `Bench notes for run fwgr46-n1` (includes the runid). Saved — verified after a fresh page reload.

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings > General > Tags lists exactly one tag: `bench` (chip "Remove \"bench\" tag"). Time range set to Last 6 hours and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox; after a fresh reload of the plain dashboard URL the time picker still shows "Last 6 hours" (URL `from=now-6h`).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Auto-refresh interval set to `1m` and persisted via the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox (the drawer registered "Changes 1" and saved). After a fresh reload the refresh button reads `1m` (aria-label: "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected").

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser address bar on a fresh load:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyflilpvk6bkf/fwgr46-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
UID: `cfyflilpvk6bkf`

Final state confirmed on a fresh, non-edit load: dashboard title `fwgr46-n1 Bench Dashboard`, panels `fwgr46-n1 Notes` (Text) and `fwgr46-n1 Availability` (Stat, TestData), time range "Last 6 hours", refresh "1m", tag `bench`, and no unsaved changes (save drawer reports "No changes to save").
